summary: Samdrupjongkhar district is overwhelmingly forested, with 1697.24 km² (90.6 %) covered by forest. Agriculture accounts for a modest 78.10 km² (4.2 %) while shrubs and water bodies cover 62.67 km² (3.3 %) and 12.44 km² (0.7 %) respectively. Built‑up, meadows, landslides and other land‑use types together comprise less than 1 % of the district’s area.
